name: Electronic-Structure Methods & Density Functional Theory
summary: Teaches first-principles calculation of materials properties using density functional theory and related quantum-mechanical methods.

topics.name: The many-body problem and the Born-Oppenheimer approximation
Hartree-Fock and the limits of wavefunction methods
Hohenberg-Kohn theorems and the Kohn-Sham equations
Exchange-correlation functionals: LDA, GGA, meta-GGA, hybrids and DFT+U
Plane-wave basis sets, pseudopotentials and PAW; k-point sampling and convergence
Computing structures, formation energies and elastic constants
Band structures and densities of states
Defect formation energies and charged defects
Phonons and thermodynamic properties from first principles
Transition states and diffusion barriers (nudged elastic band)
Beyond DFT: GW, DMFT and van der Waals corrections
Practical codes and workflows (VASP, Quantum ESPRESSO, ASE, pymatgen)
